'''Masposhani''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. According to [[Beldorion]] the Hutt, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] had once maintained a training facility in [[Caves of Masposhani|its caves]].<ref name="Planet of Twilight" />
